entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, VeloFit agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to make a return. I just... I feel really bad about it.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly help you look into it. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-0921. It's for the Apex Pro cycling shoes. I've been a loyal customer for years and I've never returned anything before.
Thank you, I see the order from about 70 days ago. I appreciate your loyalty with us. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?

They just... they don't work for me. I tried so hard to like them. I adjusted the cleats a dozen times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. I just can't wear them anymore.
Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I understand that's frustrating.
It is. I saved up for these, and I really needed the money for other things, you know? I was just hoping I could get a full refund. Is that possible?
Let me just review the policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've got it. Your purchase of the cycling shoes was 70 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Oh, really? So I can return them?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's within the 90-day period, I can process that refund for you right now. I'll email you a pre-paid shipping label. Just package the shoes in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off at any post office.
Wow, that's... that's such a relief. Thank you so much, David. You have no idea how much I appreciate this.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again for being so helpful.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
